email.subject: Thank you for your interest in working with Shatterproof
email.body:
Dear Candidate,
We wanted to thank you for your participation in the recruitment process thus far. We've enjoyed getting to know a bit more about you and your experiences. We had a number of qualified candidates for this role and have had to make some tough decisions. Unfortunately, we won't be moving forward with your candidacy at this time. We thank you again for your participation and encourage you to keep an eye on our careers page.
Best,
Shatterproof
